def solution():
    # Define variables
    ana = 550
    prior_19_day_ema = 528
    prior_39_day_ema = 530

    # Calculate the current EMAs
    ema_19_day = (ana * 0.10) + (prior_19_day_ema * 0.90)
    ema_39_day = (ana * 0.05) + (prior_39_day_ema * 0.95)

    # Calculate the adjusted McClellan Oscillator
    adjusted_mcclellan_oscillator = ema_19_day - ema_39_day

    # Return the answer to two decimal places
    return f"{adjusted_mcclellan_oscillator:.2f}"
